description: Places furniture in the rooms of a project’s model the way a planner would: by room type (living, kitchen, bedroom, bath, office, meeting…), clear of doors and windows, with 90 cm passages. One room by name or every room of a storey or of the house; "add" fills only empty rooms, "replace" furnishes anew. Changes the model; vedutum_undo_last_change takes it back. Costs no points.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

mode.description: "add" (default) leaves furnished rooms as they are; "replace" removes their furniture first

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

room.description: Only this room, by its name on the plan, e.g. "Wohnen" or "Kind 1"

storey.description: Only this storey (0 = ground floor); default every read storey

terraces.description: Also set out the ground floor terraces (default true when furnishing a whole storey)

name: vedutum_furnish_rooms
title: Furnish rooms in the model
